steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 x 20 cm baking pan with parchment paper.
Peel, core, and finely grate the 2 apples into a large bowl.
Add the unsweetened applesauce and canola oil to the grated apple and stir to combine.
Add the rolled oats, oat flour, cinnamon, and baking powder to the bowl.
Stir until a thick, uniform batter forms with no dry pockets remaining.
Spread the batter evenly into the prepared pan, pressing it down gently with a spatula.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the top is golden and the centre feels firm to the touch.
Cool completely in the pan, then cut into 16 bars.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
